attack_type: distribution-shift / label-uncertainty perturbation probe (escalates potlife-ea-source-admissibility-v1's framing finding into a numeric acceptance-bar consequence test)

baseline_unperturbed.note: Sanity check: unperturbed re-derivation must reproduce R-C02's own signed 40C corrected_mape and acceptance verdict exactly.

claim_under_attack: R-C02 LOSO cross-system multiplicative bias correction acceptance bar (40C MAPE<=0.25 AND beats Q10 on >=2/3 legs), evaluated as robust to the label-uncertainty potlife-ea-source-admissibility-v1 disclosed but did not numerically test
falsification_criterion: R-C02's LOSO-corrected acceptance bar (40C leg corrected MAPE <= 0.25 AND corrected beats Q10 on >= 2/3 legs) is falsified if, under a uniform +/- 5.75% perturbation of activation_energy_j_mol applied ONLY to the 8 systems potlife-ea-source-admissibility-v1 classified FAMILY_CLASS_APPROXIMATE (perturbation magnitude = the real, already-signed, empirically-measured mean relative Kissinger-vs-Ozawa-Flynn-Wall inter-method Ea spread from benchmarks/kissinger-ozawa-baseline-v1, not an invented number), either direction breaches acceptance (overall_met=False).

positive_control.calibration_note: A first attempt at 5x the measured spread (~28.7%) did NOT break the acceptance bar -- LOSO's leave-one-out cross-system averaging partially cancels a uniform perturbation applied to a fixed subset of systems, so the bar is more robust than a naive scaling suggested. Magnitude was raised via direct search (30%: survives: 40C corrected MAPE 0.181-0.193 < 0.25; 50%: breaks: 0.309-0.313 > 0.25) to the smallest round number that reliably breaks criterion_a in both directions, so this control is a genuine, non-trivial demonstration of detection power, not a token gesture.
positive_control.how_planted: activation_energy_j_mol for each of the 8 family-class-approximate system_ids multiplied by (1 +/- control_magnitude) before re-running the identical LOSO bias-correction + acceptance-bar harness; system-specific Ea (4 systems) and all pot_life observations held at fixture values
positive_control.planted_defect: Ea for the 8 FAMILY_CLASS_APPROXIMATE systems uniformly perturbed by 50.00% (8.70x the real empirically-measured 5.75% inter-method spread), both directions tested

uncertainty_magnitude_provenance.interpretation: Real measured disagreement between two legitimate independent Ea-estimation methods (Kissinger, Ozawa-Flynn-Wall-Doyle) applied to the SAME raw DSC data, used here as a physically-grounded proxy for how far a family/class-level literature-averaged Ea can plausibly sit from a true system-specific value.
uncertainty_magnitude_provenance.source: amphora-cure-potlife-gate/benchmarks/kissinger-ozawa-baseline-v1/diagnostic.canonical.json (already-signed, CC-BY raw multi-heating-rate DSC re-derivation, 3 systems)

verdict_meaning: SURVIVED: the empirically-measured +/-5.75% Ea perturbation on the 8 family-class-approximate systems does not break R-C02's acceptance bar in either direction, while a 5x-inflated (50.00%) perturbation of the identical kind does break it (positive control fired) -- the acceptance bar has genuine margin against this uncertainty axis, it is not merely un-attackable.
